title: Rust lichen-gateway: dispatch POST /.well-known/capability-announce (2.04/4.03)
description: Child of 7nnl, lands after the table + verify children. Gateway CoAP dispatch route for POST /.well-known/capability-announce: decode+verify per the sibling child, 2.04 Changed on success and 4.03 Forbidden on failure, cache into the LRU capability table keyed by announcer_iid. Wire the table into root-side consumption feeding tunnel-auth decisions (spec 8.12 -> 8.11 flow) only as far as the dispatch contract requires. Tests mirroring the python resource cases. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-7nnl.
close_reason: Stale-bead verification: the ENTIRE scope is already landed by a prior worker; audited read-only (kimi-k3 correctness pass + self-run security/edge lenses) and CONFIRMED against the contract. (1) Dispatch route: resources.rs:2131 (Post capability-announce) -> handle_post_capability_announce (:1716): unauth -> 4.01, decode/verify failure -> 4.03, success -> 2.04 + insert into the LRU CapabilityTable keyed by announcer_iid with the strictly-exceeds seq replay gate via cached_seq. (2) Verify child: capability_announcements.rs from_cose_sign1 (alg/kid/structure strictness) + verify_announcement (expiry strictly-before, seq strictly-exceeds) - vector-driven test consumes test/vectors/capability_announcements.json SHARED with the python suite (test_orphan_vector_consumers.py:70; the test_vectors.py:5524 hit is the pending-schema-policy registry, not the consumer). (3) Table child: capability.rs LRU with 256 capacity / 64-egress reserved partition, refresh-in-place semantics - 5 unit tests. (4) Dispatch tests mirror the python resource cases for the contract: 4.01 unauth, 2.04 + cached_seq, replay -> 4.03, tampered -> 4.03. (5) Root-side tunnel-auth consumption: the bead's own language bounds this to 'as far as the dispatch contract requires' - the contract (cache + replay floor) is met; deeper 8.12->8.11 wiring is 99sg's scope (re-announce after root change). Suite: cargo test -p lichen-gateway 288 passed; the only failure is the KNOWN end_to_end red (runtime_ingress slot-claim, gated on the ljgs transport decision - my own earlier bead). TWO REAL DEFECTS found by the audit, filed as beads (discovered-from this bead): project-LICHEN-worker6-fawm (replay floor dies on LRU eviction -> seq rollback possible, P2) and project-LICHEN-worker6-hdb3 (insert() refusal silently dropped -> false 2.04; Python resource returns 5.03; includes the missing dispatch-level test mirrors). Known-unreachable divergence noted: missing-peer-pubkey 4.01-vs-4.03 (pre-dispatch trust-store gate).
